headline: Australia Raises Interest Rates
what: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its cash-rate target by 0.25 percentage point to 4.85%.
context: It was the bank’s fifth increase this year.
why_it_matters: Australian rates influence its currency, housing costs, and a commodity-exporting economy tied closely to Asian demand.

headline: South Korean Technology Shares Fall
what: South Korea’s KOSPI fell 3.6% as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix declined.
context: The index is heavily exposed to memory chips and global technology demand.
why_it_matters: Weakness in major chipmakers can signal pressure on a supply chain used by U.S. technology companies.

headline: European Markets Trade Unevenly
what: Major European indexes were mixed while investors weighed higher oil prices and shifting interest-rate expectations.
context: The region imports substantial energy and trades heavily with the United States and Asia.
why_it_matters: Changes in European demand can reach U.S. exporters, banks, and global manufacturers.
